answer: The vintner walks the rows in March and ties a ribbon to every vine that will bear, because a vine without a ribbon is not picked. Blood donor tenure record with national blood service attestation is the ribbon's proof: ten-year donation record, 50 verified donations, health checks, yearly review. A jetty that slips past the count is one basket of grapes the press never saw, and the fable is the price of that basket, paid in coin to the estate before the harvest is weighed. The beacon is the estate roll, signed by the steward and locked in the manor chest.
